prompt: write a very short patient progress note for the history of present illness section and list what icd10 codes are most appropriate based on the symptoms and possible diagnoses listed, based on the following patient data: 40 year old male. chest pain, admitted to facility. given ntg tab x 1 . had heart cath and is now on plavix. Pt is scheduled for cabg x 4. Pt is short of air. on 2L o2 per nc.
response:
HPI: A 40-year-old male with a history of chest pain was admitted to the facility. He was given one nitroglycerin tablet and underwent a heart catheterization. He is currently on Plavix and is scheduled for a CABG x 4. He is experiencing shortness of air and is on 2L of oxygen via nasal cannula.

ICD-10 Codes: I21.0 (Acute myocardial infarction of anterior wall), I25.10 (Unstable angina without heart failure), Z51.1 (Scheduled for surgical procedure), Z95.1 (History of tobacco use)
